βαθείῃ: βαθύς — deep; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic βαθείᾳ)
βροτολοιγῷ: βροτολοιγός — man-destroying, bane of mortals; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Ares
θερμὸν: θερμός — hot, warm; masc./neut. acc. sg.
κιόντα: κίω — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going’
κοιμήσατο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. go to sleep; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκοιμήσατο)
κυλίνδεται: κυλίνδω — roll; pres. 3 sg. mid.-pass.: ’rolls, comes rolling on’
λίς: λίς — smooth, bare (of rock); adj., fem. nom. sg., predicate; accented before the enclitic ἐστι
λαίλαπι: λαῖλαψ — squall, whirlwind; fem. dat. sg.
μέτρον: μέτρον — measure, full measure; neut. acc. sg. (ἥβης μέτρον ’the measure of manhood’)
μενέω: μένω — stay, remain, wait; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic μενῶ)
μνηστῆς: μνηστός — wooed, wedded; fem. gen. sg., with ἀλόχου: ’wedded (wife)’
οἴχετ: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. 3 sg., elided (οἴχετ’ = οἴχεται), perfect sense: ’is gone’
πρῶθ: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (πρῶθ’ = πρῶτα): ’first’
σκίδναται: σκίδναμαι — spread out, scatter; pres. 3 sg. mid.
τλήσομαι: τλάω — endure, bear up under; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall endure’
χερμαδίοισιν: χερμάδιον — stone (a hand-sized throwing stone); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀνήνοθεν: ἀνήνοθα — well up, rise (perf. with pres. sense); perf. 3 sg. (ἀνήνοθε), ν-movable
ἀπέκοψε: ἀποκόπτω — cut off, sever; aor. 3 sg.: ’cut through’
ἀργιόδοντας: ἀργιόδους — white-toothed, white-tusked (of swine); masc. acc. pl., stem ἀργιοδοντ-
ἄσπετα: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, untold, unutterable; neut. nom. pl. · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with δῶρα: ‘boundless (gifts)’
ἄχνη: ἄχνη — foam, spray; fem. nom. sg.
ἐλαύνετε: ἐλαύνω — drive, row, sail; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’drive!’
ἐνόησ: νοέω — perceive, notice, devise; aor. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἐνόησ’ = ἐνόησε): ’devised’
ἐρικυδέος: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, much honoured; fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦς)
ἔθρεψε: τρέφω — rear, nurture, bring up; aor. 3 sg.
ἔνερθε: ἔνερθε — from beneath, below, underneath; adv.
ἔχῃ: ἔχω — hold, have, keep to; pres. subj. 3 sg.
ἤχθετο: ἔχθομαι — be hated, be hateful; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, + dat.: ’was hateful to’ · also ἄχθομαι — be vexed, be burdened (from ἄχθος ’load’); impf. 3 sg., augmented: of a ship, ’was weighed down, was loaded’ (sense not certain)
ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg. (ἥβης μέτρον ’the measure of manhood’)
ἰοειδέα: ἰοειδής — violet-dark, deep-coloured (of the sea); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰοειδῆ)
ἰφθίμων: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout, sturdy; masc. gen. pl.
ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο) · also augmented, with the long ι that the metre needs (ἵκετ’ ἐμὸν δῶ ’came to my house’)
ἵμασεν: ἱμάσσω — lash, whip (from ἱμάς ’strap’); aor. 3 sg.
ὀξεῖαι: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; fem. nom. pl.
ὄϊς: ὄϊς — sheep; common gender (masc. or fem.), acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς): ’sheep’
ὑψόσε: ὑψόσε — upward, on high; adv. (cf. elided ὑψόσ’)
ὤριστος: ἄριστος — best, noblest (superlative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. sg., crasis ὁ ἄριστος (ὤριστος): ’the best’
